title: Compact ops briefing cards for private tenant consoles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a set of compact, single-row 'Ops briefing' cards for the Private/VPC console that give engineering and tenant-ops quick situational awareness. Each card is meant to be scannable (<= 2 lines of text) and tap into deeper views: cluster health sparkline, rollout traffic slider, last upgrade window, egress cost delta, and active routing policy. Goal: reduce time-to-insight on status pages for on-call and platform teams while preserving drill-downs for full details.
acceptance_criteria: Landing view shows up to 6 briefing cards for a tenant in a single row without wrapping on 1280px wide screens
Each card contains: title, 7-day sparkline, SLO pill (color coded), primary metric (latency or cost delta), and a contextual shallow action (View details / Acknowledge)
Cards are keyboard navigable and meet WCAG contrast AA for badges and text
Clicking a card opens the tenant detail rail with the corresponding deep view (network path inspector / rollout inspector / upgrade timeline)
Design provides responsive collapse behavior: stacked mini-cards for mobile and compact hover tooltips for tablet
implementation_notes: Use existing sparkline component from console-ui; new compact variant (height 22px) required
SLO pill color map: green (>=99.9), amber (>=99.0 && <99.9), red (<99.0). Expose tooltip with exact percentage and incidents in last 7 days
Expose a data attribute on each card with primary_metric and last_updated for easy polling by runtime team
Rollout slider is a visual-only control in this prototype (backend gating will be separate ENG task). Use mocked traffic buckets for demo
Accessibility: ensure cards announce their label and status via aria-live when values update

Design Ops: ensure spacing tokens reuse 'space-2' and 'space-4' from tokens so CSS vars can be swapped per tenant theme
